'''Akoure Vayet''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Gray Ajah]]. 

==Appearance==
She is 5'4" or 163&nbsp;cm tall and stout{{ref/book|9|p}} with brown eyes and dark hair.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Akoure Vayet}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Akoure is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|30}}. She would not be able to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split. 

She was one of the fifty one Aes Sedai, headed by [[Toveine Gazal]], sent by [[Elaida a'Roihan]] to take out the [[Black Tower]]{{ref/book|7|p}}. 

At [[Alviarin Freidhen|Alviarin Freidhen's]] suggestion, Elaida does not help this group of sisters and abandons them {{ref/book|7|32}}. 

They were all captured and[[bond]]ed involuntarily by [[Asha'man]]{{ref/book|8|26}}. Toveine witnesses Akoure staring at her hand in disbelief after the Asha'man confiscate her [[Great Serpent ring]]{{ref/book|9|p}}.

She sent reports back to the Gray Ajah in the White Tower about the outcome of the expedition{{ref/book|11|p}}. It is likely the content of the report was only shared with the [[Sitters]].

Like many sisters held in the Black Tower she was most probably [[Turned]] to the [[Shadow]] by [[Mazrim Taim|Mazrim Taim's]] cronies.
